title: Exodia Hunt
summary: Exodia Hunt is an Arcane Enhancement for Zaws that grants a 50% chance to pull in nearby enemies on slam attacks.
extract:
Exodia Hunt is an Arcane Enhancement for Zaws that grants a 50% chance to pull in nearby enemies on slam attacks.

Effect

Acquisition
Can be bought from Hok for  10,000 per arcane upon reaching the rank of Kin with the Ostrons.

Notes
Enemies pulled in by the effect, assuming they are not already under some kind of animation lock, are staggered and will be opened up to finishers.
Rather than the slam itself being the trigger for pulling in enemies, the slam appears to activate an invisible buff which will, in turn, pull in and stagger enemies that enter into range, even as the player moves. The buff appears to last for roughly 1-2 seconds from testing.
The effect is treated as an ability, which means that it will bypass  Limbo's Rift Plane mechanic and will not affect targets affected by a nullification effect.
Combos which include slam attacks can trigger Exodia Hunt.
Applies an implosion graphical effect in bright orange and green on targets affected by the pull.
Implosion effect colors might be modifiable, however this seems buggy.

Tips
Synergizes well with the Flailing Branch staff stance, which features multiple quick slams in the Autumn Leaf combo.
Synergizes well with the Iron Phoenix sword stance, which features a slam attack at the end of its Taking Flight combo.
Synergizes well with the Twirling Spire polearm stance, which features slams at the end of multiple combos.
Synergizes well with the Tempo Royale heavy blade stance, which features a slam attack at the end of its August Mesto combo.
Synergizes very well with the Rending Crane heavy blade stance, which can trigger the effect with both hits of the Skull Splitter combo (potentially a bug). Additionally, Rampaging Boar features a slam at the end of its combo.
Synergizes well with Hammers using the Crushing Ruin stance which features slam attacks at the end of multiple combos.
In addition to this, Hammers have very high finisher damage multipliers.
It is advisable to use caution when in large groups of enemies, as it is possible to become trapped within a mass of bodies.
